messages:
alex: Flagging an authz anomaly — saw a sudden spike in `api.token.create` from service-account `svc-replicator@infra` across multiple regions. Looks like 1000+ calls in 3m. Opening command room.
ben: Copy. Have we confirmed it's not a CI job or known rollout?
alex: Checked CI schedules, nothing matches. Correlated with KMS GenerateDataKey calls - same timeframe. Sample log: `2024-11-04T01:12:05Z svc-replicator calls api.token.create user=svc-replicator request_id=abc123`
emily: Reproduced in audit logs: `projects/infra/logs/authz: resource=projects/infra/serviceAccounts/svc-replicator@infra` - multiple `iam.serviceAccounts.keys.create` attempts too.
marta: Tagging secops. @secops-bot escalate P1. Start containment runway: rotate keys, revoke tokens, and restrict the SA immediately. Who can run key rotation now?
ben: I can. Plan: 1) revoke existing keys for svc-replicator, 2) create new key with limited scope, 3) update replicator config via canary, 4) monitor for retry. Will use `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable` followed by `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create`.
alex: Also possible attacker is using cached KMS-encrypted blobs to generate tokens. Suggest we freeze outbound egress from the replicator pool while we rotate.
emily: On it — adding temporary NetworkPolicy to block egress for `ns=replicator` in cluster-prod: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-freeze-replicator
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: replicator
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
EOF`
ben: Revoking keys now. Running: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-replicator@infra` — will follow with create and encrypt new key with KMS key `projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/replica/cryptoKeys/replica-rot`
marta: Noted. Also create an audit export snapshot for secops: `bq query 'SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE protoPayload.serviceAccountEmail="svc-replicator@infra" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 6 HOUR)'`
secops-bot: Incident P1 created: INC-20241104-17. Triage channel: #secops-inc-INC-20241104-17. Pager duty notified: oncall-team and infra-oncall.
oncall-liaison: FYI I'll call product owners and stakeholder comms after containment.
alex: Action list updated: revoke keys (ben), network egress freeze (emily), KMS key rotation check (ben), audit snapshot + evidence (marta), open incident ticket (secops-bot).
ben: New key created and applied to canary replicator pod (replicator-canary-1). Observing canary — auth calls dropped to zero from that pod. Rolling plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% if stable.
emily: Egress freeze applied cluster-wide for replicator pool. Confirmed no outbound until further notice.
marta: Audit snapshot exported. Found a few anomalous IPs hitting the token endpoint: `54.210.33.45` and `3.115.200.8` — flagged for block and intel enrichment.
alex: Good work. Preparing containment summary for handoff. Timeline so far: 01:12 detection, 01:15 command room open, 01:18 network egress freeze, 01:22 key revoke/create, 01:30 canary deployed, 01:38 canary stable.
oncall-liaison: I'm taking the shift handoff in 20m. Next oncall please keep canary at 10% -> 50% holds and watch audit streams for `iam.serviceAccounts.keys.create` and `api.token.create`. Also need follow-ups: full forensics, rotate any downstream secrets that used that SA, and prepare customer impact comms (if any).
marta: I'll compile evidence and attach to INC-20241104-17. Leaving a checklist in the ticket for post-incident: (1) rotate KMS key material if suspicion persists, (2) RBAC review for svc-replicator bindings, (3) add alert for token-create burst > 50/min, (4) write postmortem.
ben: Leaving a note: I created a scoped replacement key and adjusted IAM to remove broad role `roles/owner` from replicator service account — changed to `roles/replicator.runner` in least-privilege test. Will follow with PR for policy.
emily: I'll keep the egress freeze until we have clearance from secops to relax.
oncall-liaison: Handoff: taking watch. Summary pinned to channel. All actions and artifacts uploaded to INC-20241104-17. If anything changes, ping me directly.
marta: Thanks team. Leaving war-room. Will join postmortem tomorrow 1400 UTC. :thumbsup:
